choices.content: Choose the most remote corner as the origin and do not specify a unit
Choose a prominent location, such as the flagpole or school gate, as the origin and specify the unit length
Set up a separate coordinate system for each landmark
Do not set up a coordinate system; describe locations only using “left” and “right”

question.prompt: To describe the locations of landmarks on campus, how should the origin be chosen for convenience?

solutions.explanation: The origin should be chosen at a prominent location that is easy to find (such as the flagpole or school gate), and the unit length should be specified. This gives all landmarks a common coordinate system and makes their locations easy to describe.
solutions.title: Choose an identifiable origin and unit
